name: construct multi-hop SPARQL joins across several related resource types
definition: Chain triple patterns linking individuals through roles, departments, universities, countries, classes, and enrolled students to gather all needed bindings.
failure_mode: Missing/incorrect intermediate links change which individuals are selected.

name: consume eigenvalues and per-index principal minor spectra
definition: Take a single sorted eigenvalue array and an iterable of minor-spectra arrays and reconstruct the result.
failure_mode: argument order or shape mismatch breaks the call

name: deduce that committed rows live in a WAL file for a database
definition: Recognize the database is in rolling-journal (WAL) mode where the main db shows only a baseload of rows and the newer committed records exist in the sidecar file, so reading the base alone gives an incomplete set.
failure_mode: Using a plain copy of the DB without the WAL loses the extra records.

name: filter on aggregate counts via subqueries or HAVING conditions
definition: Express a condition over an aggregated count (e.g. a department with more than a threshold number of students in its classes) using a subquery/aggregation.
failure_mode: Missing the count filter admits individuals that should be excluded.
